About est

At est, we don’t just manage money, we manage meaning. We understand that your financial life isn’t separate from your real life. It’s deeply connected to your choices, your emotions, your fears, and your dreams. That’s why we don’t see what we do as a single transaction or a one-time event. For us, it’s a lifelong relationship built on trust, honesty, and shared growth. We walk beside you, not in front of you, not behind you, but with you through every season of your life.

We know that behind every financial goal is a deeper story: a family trying to find stability, an individual chasing freedom, a couple building a legacy. And we know that most people don’t just need spreadsheets and statements, they need someone who truly listens. Someone who gets how overwhelming, frustrating, and even isolating financial stress can feel. That’s why we take the time to understand your journey, not just your numbers.

We’re here to ask better questions. What’s really holding you back? What’s keeping you up at night? What would your life look like if money wasn’t a source of stress, but a tool for clarity, choice, and confidence? That’s where we come in.

est was built to be the financial services company that changes lives, not just balances. We offer real, practical solutions tailored to your unique challenges, whether that means reducing your debt, improving your tax position, growing your investments, or simply regaining a sense of control. We treat your goals with the same seriousness and care as we treat our own.

Because when you win, we win.

Choosing financial advice is a lot like choosing a meal. On the surface, it might seem like it’s just about what’s on the plate—numbers, products, strategies. But when you really think about it, it’s never just about the meal. It’s about what that meal does for you.

Is it nourishing? Does it give you energy? Will it support your health and wellbeing long after the last bite? That’s how we approach financial planning at est. We don’t just serve up a solution, we think about how it will sustain you. Will this strategy give you peace of mind? Will this plan reduce your stress? Will it help you sleep better at night, knowing your future is secure?

Because just like a good meal fuels your body, a well-structured plan should fuel your life. It should give you confidence, clarity, and capacity to focus on what truly matters: your family, your freedom, your goals. That’s why at est, it’s not just about what we do. It’s about what our work does for you.

At est, we grow with our clients. We’re raw. We’re real. And we’re in it for the long haul. Because we believe that what we do shouldn’t just change your bank balance, it should change your life. But beyond the results, our true aim is to become a trusted presence in your life, the kind that’s not just useful but memorable. That’s what it means to us to serve with integrity and heart.

That's what it means to us to serve with integrity and heart
Your Journey with Us

01

Book your free consultation with us here.

STEP
02

Our team will be in touch shortly to discuss your goals in detail. From there, we'll assess how we can best support you and determine the most effective way forward.

STEP
03

Following that, we'll invite you to our office for a dedicated session with our property strategist, mortgage broker, or both depending on your needs, to explore tailored solutions and outline the best course of action.
